lines.text: Which hand aged? Both belong to neighbours, under the same fierce sun.
lines.phonemes: wˌɪtʃ hˈand ˈeɪdʒd? bˈəʊθ bɪlˈɒŋ tə nˈeɪbəz, ˌʌndə ðə sˈeɪm fˈiəs sˈʌn.

lines.text: In the early nineties, in a Queensland town called Nambour, chance decided who would wear sunscreen every morning. They put it on head, neck, arms and hands; neighbours used it as they pleased.
lines.phonemes: ɪnðɪ ˈɜːlɪ nˈaɪntiz, ɪn ˈeɪ kwˈiːnzlənd tˈaʊn kˈɔːld nˈæmbɔː , tʃˈans dɪsˈaɪdɪd hˌuː wʊd wˈeə sˈʌnskɹiːn ˈɛvɹɪ mˈɔːnɪŋ. ðeɪ pˌʊt ɪt ˌɒn hˈɛd, nˈɛk, ˈɑːmz and hˈandz; nˈeɪbəz jˈuːzd ɪt az ðeɪ plˈiːzd.

lines.text: Then researchers read the fine lines in silicone casts of hands. After four and a half years, the daily group showed no detectable increase in ageing.
lines.phonemes: ðˈɛn ɹɪsˈɜːtʃəz ɹˈiːd ðə fˈaɪn lˈaɪnz ɪn sˈɪlɪkˌəʊn kˈasts ɒv hˈandz. ˈaftə fˈɔː and ɐ hˈɑːf jˈiəz, ðə dˈeɪli ɡɹˈuːp ʃˈəʊd nˈəʊ dɪtˈɛktəbəl ˈɪŋkɹiːs ɪn ˈeɪdʒɪŋ.

lines.text: It's easy to think of sun damage as the burn you feel. But an ultraviolet camera picks up damage the naked eye misses, building long before anything shows on the surface.
lines.phonemes: ɪts ˈiːzi tə θˈɪŋk ɒv sˈʌn dˈamɪdʒ az ðə bˈɜːn juː fˈiːl. bˌʌt ɐn ˌʊltɹɐvˈaɪəlɪt kˈamɹə pˈɪks ˌʌp dˈamɪdʒ ðə nˈeɪkɪd ˈaɪ mˈɪsɪz, bˈɪldɪŋ lˈɒŋ bɪfˌɔːɹ ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ ʃˈəʊz ɒnðə sˈɜːfɪs.

lines.text: Then the town was watched for ten more years. Squamous cell cancers had already come out lower, and melanoma came out at about half, in small numbers.
lines.phonemes: ðˈɛn ðə tˈaʊn wɒz wˈɒtʃt fɔː tˈɛn mˈɔː jˈiəz. skwˈeɪməs sˈɛl kˈansəz had ɔːlɹˌɛdi kˈʌm ˈaʊt lˈəʊə, and mˌɛlənˈəʊmə kˈeɪm ˈaʊt at ɐbˌaʊt hˈɑːf, ɪn smˈɔːl nˈʌmbəz.

lines.text: At a lab's test dose, that morning layer is about a fifth of a paper's thickness.
lines.phonemes: atə lˈabz tˈɛst dˈəʊs, ðat mˈɔːnɪŋ lˈeɪəɹ ɪz ɐbˌaʊt ɐ fˈɪfθ əvə pˈeɪpəz θˈɪknəs.

lines.text: So, which hand aged? The eye can't say, but the skin was keeping its own record.
lines.phonemes: sˈəʊ, wˌɪtʃ hˈand ˈeɪdʒd? ðɪ ˈaɪ kˈɑːnt sˈeɪ, bˌʌt ðə skˈɪn wɒz kˈiːpɪŋ ɪts ˈəʊn ɹˈɛkɔːd.

lines.text: Next: tanning beds share a list with cigarettes. What does it mean?
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst: tˈanɪŋ bˈɛdz ʃˈeəɹ ɐ lˈɪst wɪð sˌɪɡəɹˈɛts. wˌɒt dˈʌz ɪt mˈiːn?
